preconditions.description: The to_currency parameter must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, float) for value in values_list)
preconditions.description: All elements in the values_list must be floats.
The values_list must contain at least one element.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, str) for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the return value must be strings.

postconditions.expression: all(result.endswith('€') if to_currency == 'EUR' else result.endswith('$') for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value must end with '€' if to_currency is 'EUR' and with '$' if to_currency is 'USD'.
All elements in the return value must have exactly two decimal places.
